segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from the control room; Hype Train briefly interrupts with freestyle rhetoric before being dismissed.

segments.title: AI Slop: Kevin Panera Sora 2 Showcase
segments.notes: Case reviews Discord-submitted AI videos generated via Sora 2 featuring recurring avatar Kevin Panera vaping, hijacking planes, and spawning multiverse variants (Devin Panera, Levin Panera).

segments.title: Government Shutdown & Political Clips
segments.notes: Case covers the federal shutdown, plays Ted Cruz clip appearing to say 'stop attacking pedophiles,' and airs Pete Hegseth's military address on gender-neutral fitness standards and beard bans.

segments.title: AI Rooney Returns: Upgraded Grievance Engine
segments.notes: Relaunched AI Rooney segment processes 15 viewer complaints via !RR command; Rooney's synthesized grievances fixate on 'flesh' decay, organic betrayal, and mechanical superiority before overheating.

segments.title: Crum's Return: The Hell Poster Debate
segments.notes: Crum reappears denying death/hell stint; Munch insists Crum was assistant manager in hell's transit authority and demands he retrieve his 'hang in there' poster for merch.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple's News Backlog
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reads accumulated stories: morning wood as health metric, Tilly Norwood AI actress controversy, Alex Jones Hitler mustache stunt, Japanese lab-grown meat project, EU WW3 survival kits, Jane Goodall obituary, Amazon Luna party-game pivot, Maya the Bee reboot, FCC ownership cap elimination, YouTube-Trump $24M settlement, Riyadh Comedy Festival clips.

segments.title: Stand-Up Comedy Theory Sidebar
segments.notes: Case discusses stand-up craft: persona over material, authenticity framing, Kevin Hart's stage presence, and advice to frame jokes as personal lived experience.

segments.title: Cognitive Decline Study in Young Adults
segments.notes: Neurology study shows near-doubling of cognitive difficulties (concentration, memory, decision-making) among Americans 18-39 from 2013-2023; Case and Jeff speculate on screen exposure.

segments.title: Say Less: Kevin Panera's AI Game Show
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple plays Kevin Panera's 'Say Less' word-guessing game against AI co-host La La Stardust; Jeff struggles with clue-giving constraints and loses to verbose AI guesses.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Pepito raids Danny Plats playing indie horror game Eclipseium; Case teases Friday Beyblade Burst event with improved bays.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast, reviews AI slop, moderates political desk, relaunches AI Rooney, debates Crum/Munch, discusses stand-up theory, takes call from Kendelle at close.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Briefly derails cold open with freestyle about living on death's edge and 'piss' narrative before Case cuts him.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns denying death/hell narrative; claims amnesia prank, refuses to release hell poster, asserts six billion fungal children from hell lawsuits.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Insists Crum died and worked in hell's transit authority; demands Crum retrieve poster for Munch-branded merch; threatens return trip to hell.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Hosts Amongst the Web news backlog, plays Say Less game against AI, argues with Case over text receipts and morning wood science.

characters.name: AI Rooney
characters.notes: cyborg commentator. Upgraded grievance engine processes 15 !RR complaints before overheating; fixates on flesh decay, organic betrayal, and mechanical purity.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Heard via phone call at stream end; brings breadsticks, confirms Case texted her, referred to as girlfriend by Jeff.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the federal government shutdown with clips of Ted Cruz's apparent pedophile gaffe and Pete Hegseth's gender-neutral military fitness mandate. The upgraded AI Rooney segment processes viewer grievances before overheating on flesh-obsessed rhetoric. Crum returns from alleged hell stint denying death while Munch demands poster retrieval for merch. Jeff Ripple clears a news backlog spanning AI actresses, lab-grown meat, FCC deregulation, and the Riyadh Comedy Festival. The broadcast closes with a Kevin Panera AI game show and a raid on indie horror streamer Danny Plats.
